generations.prompt: Footage from a phone's front-facing camera held at arm's length, vertical, in a plain apartment hallway with flat daylight from one side. The person in the frame looks straight into the lens with a neutral expression, mouth closed, and breathes quietly; they blink once. After about two seconds they turn their head quickly to their left, about forty-five degrees, and immediately turn it back to center, then hold still, looking into the lens, neutral, mouth closed, for the rest of the shot. The phone is handheld and nearly still, with only the slightest natural sway; no zoom, no change of framing, the background stays in place. Their mouth stays closed the whole time; they never speak, mouth words, laugh or smile. Audio: the quiet of an apartment hallway, a faint breath. No music, no speech. No on-screen text, no captions, no watermark.
